title: 1. The 16-Second Pitch & Macroeconomic Realities
desc: Training rapid cognitive articulation under strict time limits. Diego pitched his presidential campaign focusing on urban well-being, green public spaces, and poverty reduction. Louie probed the economic mechanics of salary raises, leading to a debate on currency printing, inflation, and immigration pressures across Southern Europe.
quote: "You have 16 seconds to convince me why you should be president... I will invest in the quality of life, new housing, and gardens where everyone can walk in calm."

title: 2. The Triple Lock Pension, 401(k) & Generational Divides
desc: A deep comparative breakdown of retirement safety nets. Louie analyzed the UK 'Triple Lock' (pension increases tied to inflation, average wages, or 2.5%) and government dilution of benefits. Diego contrasted this with Spain's 35-year state pension and his brother's US 401(k) retirement match, examining the generational economic gap between asset-rich pensioners and taxed young workers.
quote: "In England we have the Triple Lock Pension... it raises every year at the rate of inflation or average wage. It sounds good, but we can't afford it."

title: 3. Two Truths and a Lie: Celebrity Doors, Moncloa & Messi
desc: A masterclass in cross-examination and narrative suspense. Louie shared authentic backstage encounters (refusing entry to M.I.A. at venue openings, having beers with the Red Hot Chili Peppers over charity skateboards, and fabricating an O2 Arena meeting with Michael Jackson). Diego countered with a signed Lionel Messi FC Barcelona jersey hanging in his home and a Mallorca wedding where he unknowingly partied with the Spanish Prime Minister's personal assistant.
quote: "One of them told me that he was the assistant of the President of Spain. I really didn't know who he was until the end of the wedding."

title: 4. The Game of Life: Emotional Nuances, Ambition & Vietnamese Tết
desc: Using a checkers board to unlock profound philosophical discussions. Diego defined the purpose of art as revealing unseen truths and distinguished unconditional love from superficial lust and emotional attachment. The conversation explored Theodore Roosevelt's maxim ('Comparison is the thief of joy'), career acceleration through working abroad, and surviving wild wildlife encounters during Vietnamese Lunar New Year (Tết).
quote: "Comparison is the thief of joy... When you live and work in another country, you learn different ways to do everything, and you return with far more experience."
